description: This file defines classes and enums for Bluetooth AVDTP signaling over L2CAP, including Payload, Signal, and Socket classes, with methods for handling Bluetooth signaling messages, socket communication, and signal dispatching.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents AVDTP payload data, with builder and inspector functions.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents an AVDTP signaling message with methods for serialization, deserialization, and inspection.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Abstracts an AVDTP socket connection, handling signaling, packet processing, and signal dispatching.

classes.name: ResponseHandler
classes.description: Handles responses for signaling, with accept and reject callbacks.

classes.name: CommandType<ADMIN>
classes.description: Template class for managing signaling commands with request and response handling.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the signal label, identifier, and message type, optionally with a payload builder.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the signal into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a signal.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the signal.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a signaling request with optional payload.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Rejects a signaling request with optional error code and data.
